package main

import (
	"encoding/asn1"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"math/big"
	"os"
	"time"
)

const der = ""

type rec struct {
	Version int
	Serial  *big.Int
	Alg     asn1.ObjectIdentifier
	Name    string `asn1:"utf8"`
	Host    string `asn1:"ia5"`
	When    time.Time `asn1:"utc"`
	Ok      bool
	Blob    []byte
	Nums    []int
}

func bitLen(n int) int {
	return big.NewInt(int64(n)).BitLen()
}

func check(r *rec) int {
	sum := bitLen(r.Version) + r.Serial.BitLen() + len(r.Alg) + len(r.Name) + len(r.Host) + int(r.When.Unix()%1000) + len(r.Blob)
	if r.Ok {
		sum++
	}
	for _, n := range r.Nums {
		sum += bitLen(n)
	}
	return sum
}

func main() {
	w := "none"
	if len(os.Args) > 1 {
		w = os.Args[1]
	}
	b, _ := hex.DecodeString(der)
	var v rec
	if _, err := asn1.Unmarshal(b, &v); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("parse error:", err)
		return
	}
	sum := 0
	switch w {
	case "parse":
		for i := 0; i < 200000; i++ {
			var x rec
			if _, err := asn1.Unmarshal(b, &x); err != nil {
				fmt.Println("parse error")
				return
			}
			sum += check(&x) + i%3
		}
	case "der":
		for i := 0; i < 200000; i++ {
			out, err := asn1.Marshal(v)
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Println("der error")
				return
			}
			sum += len(out) + int(out[i%len(out)])
		}
	default:
		sum = len(b) + check(&v)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%s %d\n", w, sum)
}
